head.text: SRAM write - 68030 asynchronous cycle, 0 wait states (BUSCTRL rev 29)

signal.name: state
signal.data: S0 S1 S2 S3 S4 S5 S0 S1 S2 S3

foot.text: SRAM /WE is CPU_RW itself and the byte selects do not include AS, so the write is CE-controlled: it begins when nSRAM_BANKx_CE falls and ends when CE rises, one CPLD delay after AS negates. The 68030 only guarantees write data for 10 ns after AS negates (#25 at 20 MHz), so the end of the write relies on the data bus holding its charge.
